_note: Structured evidence/source metadata for high-risk clerkship pages and tools. Use IDs from topic_meta.evidenceIds, tool_registry.evidenceIds, and communication_cases.evidenceIds. Educational metadata only; faculty review remains required for clinical recommendations.

sources.title: Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS)
sources.evidenceLevel: validated suicide-risk screening instrument and implementation resource
sources.clerkshipRelevance: Direct questioning, suicidal ideation/behavior structure, and escalation language for supervised safety assessment.

sources.title: VA/DoD Clinical Practice Guideline for Assessment and Management of Patients at Risk for Suicide
sources.organization: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs / Department of Defense
sources.clerkshipRelevance: Supports risk formulation, safety planning, and the distinction between screening and disposition.

sources.title: Suicide Prevention Resources
sources.clerkshipRelevance: Frames suicide prevention as a supervised hospital safety process, not a stand-alone student decision.

sources.title: The ASAM Clinical Practice Guideline on Alcohol Withdrawal Management
sources.clerkshipRelevance: Supports recognition, escalation, CIWA use, thiamine, and protocol-based treatment under supervision.

sources.title: Evidence-based consensus guidelines for the management of catatonia
sources.clerkshipRelevance: Supports recognition, BFCRS use, antipsychotic caution, and escalation for lorazepam challenge/ECT.

sources.title: Delirium: prevention, diagnosis and management in hospital and long-term care
sources.organization: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
sources.clerkshipRelevance: Supports delirium recognition, prevention, nonpharmacologic management, and avoidance of sedating past medical causes.

sources.title: Verbal De-escalation of the Agitated Patient: Consensus Statement of the AAEP Project BETA De-escalation Workgroup
sources.organization: American Association for Emergency Psychiatry Project BETA
sources.clerkshipRelevance: Supports least-restrictive verbal de-escalation and relational communication under safety constraints.

sources.title: The Psychopharmacology of Agitation: Consensus Statement of the AAEP Project BETA Psychopharmacology Workgroup
sources.organization: American Association for Emergency Psychiatry Project BETA
sources.clerkshipRelevance: Supports treating the driver of agitation and using medication collaboratively when possible.
